The '''Supercopa Paraguay''' (''Paraguay Supercup'') is an annual one-match [[association football|football]] official competition in Paraguay, organised by the [[Paraguayan Football Association]] (APF) which is played by the [[Paraguayan Primera División|Primera División]] champions with the best record in the season's aggregate table and the [[Copa Paraguay]] champions, starting from 2021. This competition, created in October 2019, serves as the season's closing event and is scheduled to be played in December each year, one week after the end of the league season.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.abc.com.py/deportes/futbol/2019/10/22/creamos-la-supercopa-paraguay/|title="Creamos la Supercopa Paraguay"|publisher=ABC Color|language=es|date=22 October 2019|access-date=15 December 2021|archive-date=11 August 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230811020332/https://www.abc.com.py/deportes/futbol/2019/10/22/creamos-la-supercopa-paraguay/|url-status=live}}</ref>

The competition was originally scheduled to be played for the first time in 2020, but its implementation had to be postponed to 2021 due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Paraguay|COVID-19 pandemic]] and the cancellation of that year's Copa Paraguay.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hoy.com.py/deportes/se-viene-la-supercopa-del-futbol-paraguayo|title=Se viene la Supercopa del fútbol paraguayo|publisher=HOY|language=es|date=15 January 2021|access-date=15 December 2021|archive-date=8 October 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221008185204/https://www.hoy.com.py/deportes/se-viene-la-supercopa-del-futbol-paraguayo|url-status=live}}</ref>

==Participating clubs==

The Supercopa Paraguay is played between:
* The Copa Paraguay champions
* The best-ranked Primera División champions in the season's aggregate table

In the event the same club wins the Copa Paraguay and also ends the season as the best-ranked league champion, its rival in the Supercopa will be the champion of the remaining league tournament (Apertura or Clausura).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://versus.lanacion.com.py/versus/2021/11/08/libertad-puede-ser-supercampeon-del-2021-sin-jugar/|title=¿Libertad puede ser "supercampeón" del 2021 sin jugar?|publisher=Versus|language=es|date=8 November 2021|access-date=15 December 2021|archive-date=26 May 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230526143056/https://versus.lanacion.com.py/versus/2021/11/08/libertad-puede-ser-supercampeon-del-2021-sin-jugar/|url-status=live}}</ref>

In 2023, it was decided that if the same club won both [[Paraguayan Primera División|Primera División]] Apertura and Clausura tournaments and the [[Copa Paraguay]], the Supercopa Paraguay match would be cancelled and said club would be awarded the title automatically.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.versus.com.py/hoy/2023/11/28/se-jugara-la-supercopa-si-libertad-se-consagra-en-la-copa-paraguay/|title=¿Se jugará la Supercopa si Libertad se consagra en la Copa Paraguay?|publisher=Versus|language=es|date=28 November 2023|access-date=2 December 2023|archive-date=2 December 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231202223548/https://www.versus.com.py/hoy/2023/11/28/se-jugara-la-supercopa-si-libertad-se-consagra-en-la-copa-paraguay/|url-status=live}}</ref>

==Competition format==
*One 90-minute game at a neutral venue ([[Estadio Defensores del Chaco]])
*If tied, the winner is decided in a [[Penalty shootout (association football)|penalty shootout]]<ref name="Rules">{{cite web|url=https://www.apf.org.py/laravel-filemanager/files/69/61b0db226b107.pdf|title=REGLAMENTO DE COMPETICIÓN SUPERCOPA PARAGUAY|publisher=[[Paraguayan Football Association|APF]]|language=es|access-date=15 December 2021|archive-date=29 September 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220929151837/https://www.apf.org.py/laravel-filemanager/files/69/61b0db226b107.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>
